name: crawl4ai
description: 🚀🤖 Crawl4AI: Open-source LLM Friendly Web Crawler & Scraper. Don't be shy, join here: https://discord.gg/jP8KfhDhyN
one_liner: A tool that turns any website into clean, structured text an AI can actually read and use.
buyer: A market-research agency owner who needs continuously updated competitor pricing and content data for clients.
business_use_cases: A market research agency tracks competitor pricing and product pages daily and sells the reports to retail clients.
A RAG chatbot startup feeds a client's help-center and docs pages into their AI support bot's knowledge base.
An SEO agency scrapes search results and competitor content for monthly content-gap reports.

money_ideas.idea: Build a niche competitor-price-tracking SaaS for a specific vertical (e.g. local retail, real estate listings) billed monthly.
Offer a pay-per-crawl "website to clean data" API for other developers building AI products.

steal_this: Build a competitor price-tracking dashboard for a local retailer this weekend and charge them $50/month to keep it updated.
